lines.text: We had a pop quiz in math today.

data.define: A short test the teacher gives without warning.

example.text: We had a pop quiz in math today.

misuse.text: Don't call a planned exam a 'pop quiz'.

publish.title: What does "pop quiz" mean?
publish.value: Pop quiz = A surprise test in class. Example: "We had a pop quiz in math today." (casual English, US).
